shots.headline: 恐竜の聖域を運営
shots.sub: 群れにエサ、保護官を派遣、島を穏やかに
shots.scene: Live day ~11:00 at Medium tier, Landing Cove + Fern Valley open, mixed herds grazing, safari tram between stops, HUD (day, coins, rating) visible, 1-2 pins on the diorama, guide finished, no purchase owned

shots.headline: 適切な保護官を派遣
shots.sub: エサ係、獣医、ハンドラー、柵の技術者
shots.scene: A hungry-herd pin tapped: send sheet open with the Feeder highlighted and the route drawn along the service road, ETA shown

shots.headline: 毎朝の計画
shots.sub: エサ台とトラムの時刻表
shots.scene: Morning plan screen (paused): feed board with crates per station and the 'needs ~n a day' hint, tram timetable with 2 cars, 'Open the park' button

shots.headline: 群れの相性を考える
shots.sub: 食べ物、生息環境、気性で同居が決まる
shots.scene: Harmony card open after tapping two animals in one paddock (e.g. Triceratops + Maiasaura, green harmony bar), paddock behind it

shots.headline: 発掘して、孵化させる
shots.sub: 各発掘現場に、出る種が表示される
shots.scene: Hatchery sheet: dig site chart with the exact species per site, one egg in the incubator with the temperature slider in the warm band, 'Hatches in' timer

shots.headline: 島のトラブルを乗り越える
shots.sub: 雨、熱波、砂嵐。誰もけがをしない
shots.scene: A real rain squall day: flooded-path pin on the tram line, a Fence Tech on the way, tram waiting at the station, overcast light

shots.headline: 新しいエリアを開放
shots.sub: ファーン・バレーと砂丘のデューン・メサ
shots.scene: Dune Mesa freshly opened (bot or real save past ~2.5 h): water point and shade sail in a dune paddock, Miragaia and Protoceratops, longer tram loop

shots.headline: サンクチュアリ評価を上げる
shots.sub: 日報で、うまくいったことがわかる
shots.scene: Day report with the stars row, Sanctuary Rating, visitors, tram riders, animal care and profit, 'Next day' button; no rewarded-ad button in the frame

feature: 一日を運営し、島を穏やかに保とう
